issues.t: Rear brakes grinding from stuck outer pads
issues.sym: Squeaking or grinding from the rear, with the outer rear pads worn down while the inner pads look nearly new.
issues.why: Road salt rusts the outer rear pads so they bind and keep the brakes lightly applied. Mazda released modified pads and clips through a service bulletin.
issues.next: Have the rear brakes inspected and ask a Mazda dealer about the bulletin repair. Do not ignore grinding, which can damage the rotors.

issues.t: Driver mirror glass shakes at highway speed
issues.sym: The driver-side mirror glass vibrates at higher speeds, blurring the view behind.
issues.why: The power mirror glass mount allows vibration. Mazda issued several service bulletins with a repair.
issues.next: Ask a Mazda dealer about the mirror vibration bulletin.

issues.sym: A crack appears in the windshield with no clear rock strike.
issues.why: Early CX-5 windshields were the subject of a lawsuit, and Mazda set up a customer service program for certain vehicles built in early 2013.
issues.next: Replace the glass if the crack is in your view or spreading, and ask a Mazda dealer whether your VIN was in the program.

issues.t: Rust and paint blisters on the liftgate
issues.sym: Bubbling paint or rust spots on the lower liftgate panel or around the liftgate stopper.
issues.why: Paint was applied too thin in these areas. Mazda issued service bulletins for the repair.
issues.next: Have a Mazda dealer inspect it and ask about the bulletin before the rust spreads.

issues.sym: The liftgate won't stay up or drifts down on its own.
issues.why: The liftgate support struts can corrode internally and lose their strength.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have both struts replaced. Don't stand under a liftgate that won't stay open.

issues.t: Overheating or no heat with code P011A
issues.sym: Check engine light, the engine running hot, or the heater blowing cold air.
issues.why: Mazda issued a service alert for a temperature-reading fault on these years that can show up as overheating or poor heat.
issues.next: Have the code read and the cooling system checked. Stop driving if the temperature gauge climbs high.

issues.sym: Clunking from the front suspension over bumps or a change in handling.
issues.why: The bolts holding the front struts to the steering knuckles may not have been tightened properly.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the inspection done soon. Have any new clunk from the front checked before driving further.

issues.t: Fuel filler pipe can rupture in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs in normal driving.
issues.why: In a rear collision the fuel filler pipe could be damaged and leak fuel, raising the risk of fire.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the free repair done.

issues.sym: One or both LED running lights go out or flicker.
issues.why: Moisture can get into the headlight assembly and damage the LED running light circuit.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls; Mazda will inspect and replace the gasket or headlight as needed.

issues.t: Mazda Connect screen ghost touches, freezing and reboots
issues.sym: The infotainment screen registers touches by itself, freezes, keeps rebooting, drops Bluetooth calls, or the backup camera image fails to appear.
issues.why: Hardware and software faults in the Mazda Connect system led to a class action settlement that added extended coverage.
issues.next: Ask a Mazda dealer for the latest software and whether your screen qualifies for repair under the settlement coverage.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
issues.why: The side curtain airbags may not unfold correctly in a crash, reducing protection.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the airbags replaced promptly.

issues.t: Misfire or stalling from cylinder deactivation fault (recall)
issues.sym: Check engine light, misfire, loss of power, or the engine stalling and not restarting.
issues.why: Engine computer software could mishandle the valve adjusters when switching back from cylinder deactivation, letting an intake rocker arm move out of place and hit other engine parts.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and have the engine computer updated. If the engine misfires or loses power, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.sym: Rough running, hesitation, the engine stalling while driving, or not starting.
issues.why: The impeller inside the low-pressure fuel pump can crack and stop the pump.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls and get the fuel pump replaced. A stall at speed is a crash risk.
